title: Find the full names and phone numbers of members who attended events with m
question: Find the full names and phone numbers of members who attended events with more than 20 attendees, incurred an expense over $20 between September 10, 2019 and November 19, 2019, and that expense was linked to a closed food-related budget item.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m."XCL_035" AS first_name,
    m."XCL_036" AS last_name,
    m."XCL_040" AS phone_number
FROM member AS m
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    WHERE a."XCL_001" IN (
        SELECT a2."XCL_001"
        FROM attendance AS a2
        GROUP BY a2."XCL_001"
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
    )
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT ex."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS ex
    INNER JOIN budget AS b ON ex."XCL_023" = b."XCL_003"
    WHERE ex."XCL_020" > 20
      AND ex."XCL_019" BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
      AND b."XCL_004" = 'Food'
      AND b."XCL_008" = 'Closed'
)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035" || ' ' || m."XCL_036" AS full_name, m."XCL_037" AS phone
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON m."XCL_034" = a."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN event AS e ON a."XCL_001" = e."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN budget AS b ON b."XCL_009" = e."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN expense AS ex ON ex."XCL_023" = b."XCL_003"
WHERE ex."XCL_020" > 20
  AND ex."XCL_019" BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND b."XCL_004" = 'Food'
  AND b."XCL_008" = 'Closed'
  AND e."XCL_010" IN (SELECT "XCL_001" FROM attendance GROUP BY "XCL_001" HAVING COUNT(*) > 20)
